# Gasses 4 Advanced gasses that have highly unique properties that make them highly sought after.
## Nitrium
An incredibly valuable gas that rapidly accelerates biological functions when inhaled, causing wounds to rapidly heal themselves and boosting reaction speeds. Heavy intake causes genetic degradation from uncontrolled cellular replication.
Nitrium is created by combining 3 nitrogen, 2 tritium, and 1 pluoxium to create 3 nitrium. Nitrium forms over 500K and forms slower the higher the pressure is.
When tritium is diluted with hydrogen, the hydrogen acts as a substitute for trit, but requires at least some trit to be present. The presence of BZ acts as a catalyst which speeds up the reaction but also increases nitrogen consumption.
## Hyper-Noblium
Incredibly stable, hyper-noblium actively prevents most other reactions around it from occuring when in great enough quantities.
Hyper-noblium has the best specific heat, making it the best working fluid to store and transfer heat.
Hyper-noblium is created by combining 1 tritium with 2 nitrogen below 15 K but produces a large amount of heat. Additionally, the presence of BZ acts as a catalyst which reduces tritium consumption and heat output massively.
## Proto-Nitrate
An incredibly useful gas used to turn plasma derived gasses into more plasma, either to recycle unwanted gasses or as complex production chains to turn mundane gasses into more plasma.
Proto-nitrate converts almost all plasma based gasses, exempting pluoxium, ulnitranium, and BZ. BZ can be decomposed by PN, but instead effectively turns nitrous oxide into helium.
Conversion occurs faster with lower pressure and higher temperature, and consumes large amounts of heat while releasing massive quantities of helium as a byproduct. Proto-nitrate is consumed relative to plasma production.
Proto-nitrate can be created by combining 10 hydrogen and 1 pluoxium between 5000 K and 10000 K.
